ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: 0.18:0.82 (Ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface area).

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned, vertical and diagonal linear high-intensity disruptions (rake marks) primarily located in the lower-central dark quadrants of the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle rosette scarring on distal tips and various linear rake marks on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, saw-tooth jagged profile of the right lobe distal tip compared to the left.
